Chin-hwa Chakraborty has built a reputation on reliability rather than flash â€” he shows up, he delivers, he collects.

example_lines: "I don't break things. I introduce structural critiques."

story_hooks: Djeneba Orlov-Obeng discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Djeneba Orlov-Obeng's reputation â€” and a price for silence

narrative_function: As a saboteur, Djeneba Orlov-Obeng embodies the tension between independence and isolation. He is a lens for examining how people maintain humanity in a profession that incentivizes its erosion.
augmentations: Geneware muscle density treatment â€” looks natural, hits like chrome. Internal air filtration system â€” lungs replaced with synthetic equivalents, immune to gas attacks
daily_life: Lives nocturnally. The work happens at night, so the body follows. Days are for sleeping, equipment maintenance, and the occasional meeting with fixers who keep normal hours. The circadian disruption is permanent and accepted.
affiliation: Unaffiliated â€” too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: mechanical aptitude â€” can repair or modify almost anything
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
poor impulse control in specific triggers

decision_rules: Always has an exit route planned before agreeing to any meeting
Never works with the same crew twice in a row â€” pattern avoidance as survival strategy
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess â€” read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate â€” try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate â€” make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence â€” surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement â€” overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol â€” abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation â€” checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Checks exits within 10 seconds of entering any room
Takes a specific route home every time, varying only one block per trip â€” paranoia as lifestyle
Keeps a physical paper notebook â€” no digital record of personal thoughts
Carries a specific caliber round as a lucky charm â€” has never fired it
breaking_points: Betrayal by the one person they actually trust â€” the single point of failure in their emotional architecture
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.heritage: Mixed global ancestry with South Asian plurality (40.3%), significant Northern European admixture (32.5%), complemented by Sub-Saharan African (14.3%), Middle Eastern (7.3%), and East Asian (5.6%) heritage. This genetic mosaic creates a phenotype of considerable complexity: warm medium-deep brown skin with golden undertones from the South Asian-Sub-Saharan foundation, enriched by Northern European influence that deepens rather than cools the overall tone. Facial structure reflects the angular definition of South Asian and East Asian bone geometryâ€”high, prominent cheekbones, defined nasal bridge, eye-set that speaks to multiple continental sourcesâ€”softened by the fuller features inherited from Sub-Saharan and Middle Eastern ancestry. The overall effect is a face that resists easy categorization, bearing the genetic signature of the Ubiquitous Diaspora.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with visible muscle definition from geneware enhancement; low body fat, wiry strength rather than bulk. Chest and shoulders show the telltale density of chrome muscle treatment â€” they move with inhuman precision.
physical_description.hair_style: Kept short and tight, minimal styling. Pragmatic cut for his line of work.
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with faint amber undertone
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-deep brown with golden undertones, slightly muted by nocturnal lifestyle but retaining the richness of South Asian-Sub-Saharan heritage blended with Northern European influence. The nocturnal pallor sits beneath rather than displacing the natural warmth.
physical_description.complexion: Angular jawline and high, prominent cheekbones reflecting the South Asian-East Asian-Sub-Saharan ancestry blend, with subtle fullness in the lower face from Middle Eastern and Sub-Saharan heritage. Skin shows the strain of night-cycle livingâ€”faint dark circles beneath warm brown eyesâ€”but is clear and scar-free on the face. Grooming is meticulous and functional; no jewelry, no flash.
distinguishing_marks: Faint linear scarring along left collarbone and down the sternum â€” surgical markers from lung replacement procedure, visible when shirtless
Pale burn marks across the inner right forearm in a grid pattern â€” old electrical accident, deliberate choice not to correct
Small tool-mark tattoos on the inside of both wrists in minimalist script â€” contract confirmation marks in the saboteur underground
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome geneware musculature visible under the skin of forearms, shoulders, and upper chest â€” not bulky, but with an unnatural density and subtle metallic sheen under certain lighting. The musculature moves with mechanical precision that betrays its artificial nature. No visible neural ports, optical implants, or external chrome.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision â€” no wasted motion. Stands with slight forward lean, shoulders loose but alert. Natural state appears to be coiled tension; even at rest, his body reads as ready to move. Eyes track exits and structural weak points instinctively.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian. Dark-colored cargo pants with reinforced panels and hidden pockets for tools. Black or charcoal synthetic jacket with asymmetrical chest pockets and articulated shoulders â€” brands like Cerberus Tactical or unmarked knockoffs from the Gray Zone. Steel-toed work boots, scuffed and worn. No corpo branding, no gang colors. Clothing is chosen for function: durability, mobility, pockets for equipment. Everything fits close enough to move but loose enough to hide things.
